content: The Open Data Kit (ODK) zip file contains three Excel sheets formatted for use with ODK. These files are as follows: 1. ODK_EQuestionnaire_Screening_Interview: This file includes both the screening and interview programs combined. It is recommended to use this file if the screening and interview processes will be conducted on the same tablet, in the same location, or by the same staff member. 2. ODK_EQuestionnaire_Screening: This file contains only the screening program. It is suitable for situations where a participant will be screened in one location or by one person and then transferred to another location or staff member for the interview process. If using this file, you must also use the ODK_EQuestionnaire_Survey file. 3. ODK_EQuestionnaire_Survey: This file contains only the interview program. It is intended for use when a participant is screened in one location or by one person and then transferred to another location or staff member for the interview process. If using this file, you must also use the ODK_EQuestionnaire_Screening file. Instructions for Setting Up ODK Collect: 1. Download the ODK Collect application from the Google Play Store onto your tablet. 2. Open the ODK Collect app. The main menu will display options such as Fill Blank Form, Edit Saved Form, and Send Finalized Form. 3. Access the settings by clicking the three vertical dots in the top-right corner and selecting General Settings. 4. Under Server Settings, choose Configure Platform Settings. 5. In the URL field, enter the web address of your data server, appending your account username after the last backslash. 6. Input your account username in the Username field. 7. Enter your account password in the Password field. 8. Return to the main menu by clicking the back button, then select Get Blank Form. 9. You will see a list of forms uploaded to your server account. Select the forms you wish to download onto the tablet. The download process may take a few seconds to several minutes, depending on the internet speed and file size. Once the forms are downloaded, you will receive a notification. 10. After downloading the forms, you can turn off Wi-Fi. Return to the main menu and select Fill Blank Form to access the forms. After completing a form, you can save it locally. To send the completed form to the server, reconnect to Wi-Fi. Troubleshooting: If the forms do not download successfully, verify that all settings have been entered correctly. If the settings are correct, turn off the Wi-Fi connection, wait a few seconds, and then turn it back on. If the issue persists, restart the tablet by turning it off and on again.
